performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body: Final real-caller review found that recovered RDF numeric literals could parse as nonfinite f64 values, which the shared JSON writer represents as null. The selected capture contract requires finite numeric fields. This PR is held while recovery gains an explicit finite-decimal refusal and tiny-RDF controls for score/threshold NaN, infinities and overflow. Existing source/JSON controls passed; the final package rerun and independent focused review are pending. No corpus or model operation is required. Principles 4 and 7; full1776 and installed/corpus acceptance remain open.

Recovery now rejects NaN, infinities and binary64 overflow in both scores and thresholds before constructing successful capture output. Errors identify the subject and predicate. All38package tests passed, including ten nonfinite/refusal cases and actionable-field assertions; strict prebuild Clippy, shared-helper gate, actual source-only producer recipe and formatting passed. Independent focused source review found no remaining correctness issue. Normal follow-up commit/push hooks passed; full installed/corpus acceptance remains open. No corpus or model operation was run.

The aggregate docstring finding is addressed with targeted contracts on all seven manual JSON codec/recovery functions: policy branch decoding, native member errors, finite typed scores, semantic admission boundaries, required/optional output ordering and actionable recovered-field refusals. This changes documentation only. All38runtime controls and strict lint remain applicable; final formatting/source recipe and normal commit/push hooks passed again. The hosted coverage percentage itself has not been rerun locally and remains a CI metric under the recorded campaign exception.
